import json
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from pinnstorch.api import Coordinates,Equation
from scripts.benchmark_robin_execution import load_model
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False
torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest')
rows=[]
generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261016)
for seed in (19,1234):
 trial=Path(f'numerical-reports/polynomial-neumann-baseline-001/seed-{seed}/heat_neumann_polynomial2d-{seed}')
 factory,model=load_model(trial,'robin_grouped','recursive','cuda')
 assert all(b.kind=='neumann' and b.value==0 and b.value_function is None for b in factory.settings.boundaries)
 derivatives=[]
 for axis,name in enumerate('xy'):
  for side in (0.,1.):
   raw=torch.rand((64,3),generator=generator).to('cuda');raw[:,-1]*=.5;raw[0,-1]=0;raw[1,-1]=.5
   columns=[raw[:,i:i+1].detach().requires_grad_() for i in range(3)]
   columns[axis]=torch.full_like(columns[axis],side,requires_grad=True)
   output=dict(model(columns[:-1],columns[-1]))
   normal=Equation(output,Coordinates(dict(zip('xy',columns[:-1])),columns[-1])).diff('u',name)*(-1 if side==0 else 1)
   derivatives.append(normal.detach())
 values=torch.cat(derivatives)
 rows.append(dict(seed=seed,boundary_points=len(values),boundary_operator_rmse=float(values.square().mean().sqrt()),boundary_operator_max_error=float(values.abs().max())))
report=dict(contract=1,device='cuda',torch=torch.__version__,precision='FP32, TF32 off',rows=rows,limitations='Independent physical normal derivatives at 64 points per face, including t=0 and t=0.5. Prescribed normal derivative zero. Separate from boundary_rmse, which measures temperature error on faces. Finite sample, not a global certificate; no training or optimizer updates.')
Path('numerical-reports/polynomial-neumann-boundary-001.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report))
